arStrings.szText: The {c_highlight}Season Rank{/c} can be found in the {c_highlight}Seasons{/c} tab in the Menu.
{c_highlight}Seasonal items{/c} only last the current season. Seasonal characters will be moved to the {c_highlight}Eternal Realm{/c} when the current season ends.
Follow the {icon:Quest_Season_Progress, 2.0}{c_highlight}Seasonal Quest Marker{/c} on the Map or in the Journal to explore Seasonal content.
